baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence runs from يَثْقَفُوكُمْ through becoming enemies, extending hands and tongues, and wishing for تَكْفُرُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successful detection or capture opens a coercive episode. Hostility becomes present in action, reaches the addressees through bodily force and speech, and aims beyond immediate injury at a changed confessional posture.

activation_trace.role: Finding and taking supplies the conditional breach that gives the hostile sequence access to its target.
Coming into temporal presence makes enmity an enacted condition once capture occurs.
The released, reaching hand supplies the outward vector of coercion toward the addressees.
Hand as force turns bodily extension into exercised capacity rather than mere gesture.
Tongue as language supplies a parallel verbal channel for the same pressure.
That which causes harm supplies the payload shared by the reaching instruments.
Wishing marks the desired downstream result and distinguishes hostile aim from accomplished conversion.
Obscuring truth supplies the intended terminal change in the addressee.

changed_reading.before: A warning that enemies will physically attack, verbally abuse, and prefer the believers' disbelief.
changed_reading.after: A compact encounter-to-coercion chain in which capture activates force and discourse together to alter what the addressees can acknowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَثْقَفُوكُمْ initiates pressure by hands and tongues whose desired endpoint is تَكْفُرُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The straightening-tool branch of ث ق ف makes capture resemble forced re-forming. Once the adversary has leverage, power and transmitted speech operate like implements that bend the target into a prescribed posture of covering or denial.

activation_trace.role: Straightening a bent object with an implement supplies the exploratory image of capture as coercive re-forming.
Hand as enforcing authority supplies the physical and institutional pressure used to impose the new shape.
Tongue as message delivery makes repeated verbal transmission the discursive implement of re-forming.
Covering supplies the imposed final posture toward what had been visible or confessed.

changed_reading.before: Capture merely gives enemies an opportunity to hurt the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Capture gives enemies an opportunity to re-form the addressees by coordinated force and messaging until acknowledgment is covered over.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَعْدَاءً, the outward spreading of hands and tongues, بِالسُّوءِ, and the wish that the addressees themselves تَكْفُرُونَ form a source-channel-recipient pattern.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hostility behaves like a condition that crosses a boundary. Hands and tongues are spreading channels, harm is the transmissible load, and the desired sign of successful transmission is that the recipients reproduce covering within themselves.

activation_trace.role: A condition passing from its bearer to another supplies the cross-person mechanism for hostility.
Spreading and extension supply the movement from hostile source toward recipient.
Affliction supplies a material analogy for the harmful load carried through contact and speech.
Covering appearing in the recipient supplies the intended propagated state.

changed_reading.before: The enemies want a separate bad outcome for the addressees.
changed_reading.after: The enemies seek to transmit their own hostile closure through contact and language until it is reproduced as covering in the addressees.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The protasis إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ governs يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً, while وَدُّوا names an intention rather than a completed result.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse profiles what a relation becomes under successful hostile access. It does not need to make enmity an unchanging essence, and the final wish preserves a gap between attempted coercion and the addressees' actual response.

activation_trace.role: Successful finding or capture supplies the condition under which the profile is activated.
Occurrence in time supplies actualization without requiring permanent essence.
Enmity names the enacted relation inside the conditional episode.
Desire for an outcome leaves that outcome unrealized and therefore resistible.

changed_reading.before: The people described are enemies in a timeless and exhaustive sense, and disbelief follows their attack.
changed_reading.after: Their enmity is an operational state actualized by gained access, while the wished-for inner result remains distinct from what their pressure can guarantee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence supplies deliberately acquired proximity, cast communication, and concealed affection. That makes the focus capture less like a chance battlefield encounter and more like hostile leverage entering through a relationship and information channel already opened toward it.

activation_trace.role: Finding and taking turns prior access into usable hostile possession.
Released reach supplies the exploitation that follows gained access.
Deliberately acquiring a relation supplies the initial opening rather than accidental contact.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the reduced distance through which leverage can travel.
Receiving and transmitting speech supplies an information channel that the focus tongues can reverse against the sender.
Concealment in the interior makes hidden communication the vulnerable substrate of later exposure.

structural_cues: 60:1 places repeated enmity, affection, covering, and hidden communication immediately before 60:2's conditional capture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired proximity, cast speech, secrecy, and subsequent capture; I supply the arrow from opened channel to exploitable leverage. A live alternative is that 60:2 describes wholly external capture rather than exploitation of leaked information.

changed_reading.before: If adversaries happen to catch the addressees, they will attack them.
changed_reading.after: Relational proximity and concealed messaging can furnish the very route by which adversaries gain purchase and turn communication back into force and hostile speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Future separation and the quoted declaration in 60:4 make speech an act that exposes and installs a boundary. The focus tongues can therefore do more than insult: their harmful language can publicly classify the addressees, manifest enmity, and help make separation socially operative.

activation_trace.role: Tongue as language supplies the instrument that can enact a social distinction.
The enemy relation supplies the boundary that speech makes public and effective.
A judgment that distinguishes opposing sides supplies the wider separating frame.
Uttered speech supplies the explicit act by which a relation is declared before others.
Openly manifesting enmity supplies the result that hostile language can perform.

structural_cues: 60:3 moves to decisive separation, and 60:4 embeds direct speech immediately before enmity and hatred become manifest between parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separating judgment, uttered declaration, and manifested enmity; I infer that language can help constitute the boundary rather than merely report it. The alternative is that the focus tongues denote abuse only, while 60:4's speech is structurally independent counter-speech.

changed_reading.before: Their tongues add verbal abuse to physical attack.
changed_reading.after: Their tongues may weaponize public naming and declaration, making hostility and exclusion socially real as well as emotionally painful.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plea not to be made a trial for those who cover sharpens the focus pressure into an evidentiary contest. Enemy hands and tongues seek not only the addressees' inward denial but a visible collapse that can be treated as proof, temptation, or vindication by the persecutors.

activation_trace.role: Coercive straightening supplies pressure intended to alter the target's displayed posture.
Blocking acknowledged truth supplies the adversary's desired observable outcome.
Testing a person as metal is tested supplies the scene in which pressure is read as evidence of what the person contains.
Turning someone away from truth supplies the directional outcome sought through the trial.

structural_cues: 60:5 asks not to be made a فتنة specifically for those characterized by كفر, repeating the focus endpoint as the audience of the trial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercive re-forming, desired covering, and a human test that can turn from truth; I infer that a coerced collapse becomes public evidence for the coercer. The live alternative is a broader prayer against defeat without any adversarial evidentiary logic.

changed_reading.before: The enemy simply wants the addressees to abandon belief.
changed_reading.after: The enemy wants coercion to produce a visible collapse whose spectacle can test others and appear to validate the enemy's own position.

context_deltas.mechanism: 60:7 places the same enmity and affection axis under an act of making and capacity. This confirms the focus conditional reading: hostile enactment under capture is real and dangerous, yet the relation itself remains transformable rather than ontologically fixed.

activation_trace.role: Temporal actualization lets hostility be fully real in its episode without making it immutable.
The enemies' wished-for result supplies one pole of a contest over what relation will be produced.
Making something become a new condition supplies the explicit transformation operator.
Existing enmity supplies the relation that is available for transformation.
Affection supplies a positive successor state to the focus enemy relation.
Effective capacity supplies the possibility that relational reversal can actually be brought about.

structural_cues: 60:7 restages ع د و and و د د from 60:2 but reverses their alignment: affection can be made between parties previously in enmity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional hostile state and later explicit making of affection from enmity; I infer that 60:2 profiles conduct under access rather than permanent essence. The alternative is that only some members or a later generation undergo the change.

changed_reading.before: The warning identifies an unchangeable enemy class.
changed_reading.after: The warning accurately predicts what gained hostile access activates, while leaving the relation itself open to a later, divinely enabled reversal into affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The 60:8-9 contrast sorts relations by enacted conduct: justice remains due toward those who do not fight or expel, while prohibition attaches to fighting, expulsion, and assistance in expulsion. The focus conditional profile therefore functions as a behavior threshold evidenced by hostile reach, not as a license to infer danger from an undifferentiated label.

activation_trace.role: Actual capture supplies a concrete event by which hostile capacity becomes observable.
Crossing a rightful limit supplies the conduct criterion beneath the enemy relation.
Equity toward the non-aggressing group supplies the control case that prevents category-wide hostility.
Strengthening another by one's backing supplies indirect participation in the harmful conduct threshold.
Withholding or confining someone from a right supplies the moral result of ignoring the conduct boundary.

structural_cues: 60:8 and 60:9 form a near-minimal contrast between no fighting or expulsion and fighting, expulsion, or backing expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional capture profile followed by an explicit conduct contrast and equity command; I infer that the focus warning is diagnostic of enacted aggression. The alternative is that 60:2 addresses a narrower named group while 60:8-9 establishes a separate general rule.

changed_reading.before: Membership in an opposing group is enough to predict and govern every relation.
changed_reading.after: The focus supplies a vivid operational signature of transgressive access, while later justice remains keyed to what people actually fight, expel, enable, or refrain from doing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of giving an aggressor one's back as support activates a distributed reading of the focus hands. Hostile reach can include enabling power, allies, and delegated capacity, while tongues carry the messaging that coordinates or legitimates that reach.

activation_trace.role: Supported force lets hands signify enabled capacity beyond the attacker's own limb.
Message delivery supplies the coordination and public warrant that can accompany indirect force.
Providing one's back as aid supplies the context trigger for proxy or networked hostility.
Alliance as love and support supplies the relationship through which another actor's reach is amplified.

structural_cues: 60:9 distinguishes direct fighting and expulsion from ظَاهَرُوا عَلَىٰ إِخْرَاجِكُمْ, then makes alliance with that coalition consequential.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hand as supported force, tongue as message, and later backing of expulsion; I infer a network through which capacity and narrative extend beyond direct perpetrators. The alternative is simple face-to-face assistance with no institutional or proxy layer.

changed_reading.before: Hands and tongues belong only to the immediate captors who strike and insult.
changed_reading.after: Hands can include the enabling capacity of a hostile network, and tongues can coordinate or legitimate harm carried out through that network.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus adversary tries to manufacture a changed identity through capture, force, and speech. In 60:10, inward claims are instead tested, women are not returned to coercive custody, and binding ties are released. This supplies a procedural counter-model: discern and disentangle rather than seize and forcibly reshape.

activation_trace.role: Instrumental straightening supplies the coercive identity-making against which the later procedure contrasts.
Obscured truth supplies the inner-state dispute that hostile pressure tries to settle by force.
A test that discloses what is in the heart supplies a non-coercive procedure for evaluating claimed identity.
Holding and confining supplies the bond that the instruction refuses to preserve indiscriminately.
A binding hold that protects also supplies the legal tie that must be recognized as no longer protective in this case.

structural_cues: 60:10 repeats faith and covering around migration, examination, non-return, and the release of marital bonds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile re-forming in 60:2 and examination plus release of custody and bonds in 60:10; I infer that the later procedure answers the same contest over identity without mirroring coercion. The alternative is a purely marital ruling with no deliberate contrast to the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns bodily danger followed by an unrelated wish for disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The bodily danger is part of a struggle to control identity, later answered by testing claims, refusing coercive return, and legally disentangling bonds rather than forcing confession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compensation sequence in 60:11 activates a material layer in the focus reaching hands. Hostile access can produce loss, outflow, and failed recovery, while the prescribed response restores an equivalent amount rather than reproducing the enemy's open-ended reach.

activation_trace.role: Hand-to-hand transfer supplies an economic register latent within the hostile physical reach.
Something escaping recovery supplies the loss generated when hostile separation succeeds.
Money going out supplies the measurable material consequence of the disrupted relation.
An equivalent counterpart supplies bounded restorative repair in place of retaliatory excess.

structural_cues: 60:10-11 repeatedly tracks payments, losses across the hostile boundary, and restoration by an equivalent amount.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hand as transfer and a later sequence of loss, expenditure, and equivalence; I infer that hostile reach has a dispossessive layer repaired through measured reciprocity. The alternative is that the focus hands denote assault only and the later accounting is an independent consequence of marital separation.

changed_reading.before: Extending hands means only striking bodies.
changed_reading.after: Hostile reach can also dispossess and redirect material flows, while the later answer limits repair to recoverable equivalence rather than mirrored aggression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge's sequence of stunning falsehood, fabricated accusation, and what is placed between hands and feet gives the focus bad tongues a production mechanism. Verbal harm can be manufactured, embodied in an alleged scene, and circulated as if the hands themselves furnished proof.

activation_trace.role: A lying tongue supplies the agent that manufactures rather than merely reports harm.
Inflicting a defect or disgrace supplies the reputational payload of the speech.
A lie that stuns speaker or hearer supplies the socially disabling force of the accusation.
Inventing a falsehood supplies the fabrication step in the harmful speech mechanism.
The space before or between the hands supplies an embodied stage on which fabricated speech is made to look evidential.

structural_cues: 60:12 places fabricated calumny directly between hands and feet, bringing false speech and bodily imagery into one construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lying tongue in the focus and later fabricated calumny located between hands and feet; I infer a mechanism that stages false speech as embodied evidence. The alternative is that the pledge formula is an independent prohibition with no backward illumination of the enemy tongues.

changed_reading.before: Bad tongues insult or threaten the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Bad tongues may fabricate socially stunning accusations and stage them as embodied facts, extending hostile reach into reputation and communal standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing comparison joins severed hope to those hidden in graves. Read back through the focus contagion branch, enemy pressure seeks to pass on not merely a proposition called disbelief but a closed horizon in which truth, return, and future possibility are covered over.

activation_trace.role: A condition crossing from one bearer to another supplies the exploratory transmission mechanism.
Outward spreading supplies the path by which a closed outlook is pressed onto another person.
Covering supplies the recipient state in which alternatives and acknowledged truth disappear from view.
Hope cut off supplies the affective and temporal content of the closure.
Concealment of the dead supplies the terminal image for a future treated as shut and inaccessible.

structural_cues: 60:13 repeats covering and twice repeats severed hope before ending on the companions of graves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transmissible hostility, wished-for covering, repeated hopelessness, and burial; I infer that coercion tries to transmit a closed future. The alternative is that 60:13's despair concerns only resurrection and should not be projected into 60:2's interpersonal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The enemies want assent to a contrary creed.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory affective level, they want pressure to close the addressees' horizon until acknowledged truth and hope of return are covered like something placed beyond reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the activated branches ordinarily carry social openness, blessing, message delivery, and affection, while the syntax explicitly marks hostility and harm. It remains anchored in بسط, hands, tongues, سوء, and ود; render it only as an ironic inversion in which apparently relational gestures are weaponized, never as a claim that the verse calls the attack benevolent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adversaries extend hands and tongues toward the addressees with harm, then express a wish about their response.

activation_trace.role: Social and verbal openness supplies the outwardly familiar form that hostile intent can counterfeit.
Hand as favor supplies the positive gesture whose direction is poisoned by the explicit harmful payload.
Message delivery supplies an apparently communicative offer that can carry coercive content.
Harm explicitly reverses the positive affordances of gesture and message.
Affection remains present as an ironic lexical shadow behind a wish directed toward the target's loss.

changed_reading.before: The hostile approach is transparently violent from first gesture to final wish.
changed_reading.after: One live outlier sees a poisoned openness: gestures, messages, or apparent favor can preserve the form of relationship while carrying a coercive payload.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant split targets for ع د و rather than the direct enmity branch. It remains valid as an abductive operational overlay anchored in أَعْدَاءً and the quick capture sequence; render it as possible preparation and habituation behind hostile conduct, not as a lexical replacement of enemy with equipment or habit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rapid successful capture is followed by an immediate, coordinated hand-and-tongue response from plural أَعْدَاءً.

activation_trace.role: Quick skill in perception and action supplies the competence needed for a ready response.
Preparation of provisions or equipment supplies the outlier image of hostile readiness before encounter.
Habit and repeated practice supply the possibility that the coordinated response is rehearsed rather than improvised.
Temporal occurrence supplies the moment when stored readiness becomes enacted hostility.

changed_reading.before: Hostility erupts spontaneously once the adversaries encounter the addressees.
changed_reading.after: A contained outlier reads the speed and coordination as the activation of prepared, practiced hostility when an opportunity for capture appears.

strongest_changes: The conditional is an encounter-to-coercion chain: gained access activates force and language aimed at changing acknowledgment, not merely inflicting pain.
60:1 turns capture into possible exploitation of proximity, secrecy, and an information channel already opened toward the adversary.
60:7 preserves the danger while reversing a fixed-essence reading: enacted enmity can later be made into affection.
The 60:8-9 contrast makes hostile conduct, including indirect backing, the operative threshold while retaining equity toward non-aggressors.

60:10-12 expose procedural, material, and reputational layers: coerced identity is answered by examination and release, loss by equivalence, and bad tongues can fabricate embodied-looking accusations.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's short sequence supports several coexisting mechanisms without collapsing them: direct seizure, coercive re-forming, contagion, contingent relational actualization, networked force, and manufactured reputation. The most consequential contextual surprise is that the same enmity-affection axis is reversible, while later conduct distinctions keep that openness from weakening the immediate warning.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic scope of بِالسُّوءِ over hands, tongues, or both affects how tightly the two channels share one payload.
The straightening, contagion, poisoned-openness, and prepared-habit readings are branch-licensed analogies whose exact operative strength remains uncertain.
The procedural and compensation sequences may deliberately answer the focus coercion mechanism, or they may be later applications connected only by recurring roots and social circumstances.
The closed-future reading from 60:13 may capture an affective transmission mechanism, but it remains more remote than the direct capture and conduct models.
